commit 9e1ffd856614fcfc0bb3b89501600827cc8705e7
Author: James Bonfield <jkb@sanger.ac.uk>
Date:   Thu Nov 23 17:20:01 2023 +0000

    Disable hts_set_fai_filename call in hts_open_fuzzer.

    This is because we don't know that ../c2.fa is a valid path as it's
    relative to where we are.  We can reenable with -DFUZZ_FAI.

diff --git a/test/fuzz/hts_open_fuzzer.c b/test/fuzz/hts_open_fuzzer.c
index 59f1964b..2818eb1a 100644
--- a/test/fuzz/hts_open_fuzzer.c
+++ b/test/fuzz/hts_open_fuzzer.c
@@ -68,8 +68,12 @@ static void view_sam(const uint8_t *data, size_t size, char *mode,
     if (!out)
         abort();

+#ifdef FUZZ_FAI
     // Not critical if this doesn't work, but can test more if
     // we're in the right location.
+    //
+    // We can't rely on what the pwd is for the OSS-fuzz so we don't enable
+    // this by default.
     if (hts_set_fai_filename(out, "../c2.fa") < 0) {
         static int warned = 0;
         if (!warned) {
@@ -77,6 +81,8 @@ static void view_sam(const uint8_t *data, size_t size, char *mode,
             fprintf(stderr, "Warning couldn't find the c2.fa file\n");
         }
     }
+#endif
